text_block_list.text:
Trainy-P, Trainy-P! Ain't I totally 
slaying?

text_block_list.text:
It's here! Uchi-chan is the best! Honk

text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna keep slaying next time too! 
Keep the hype up for me, Tre-pi☆"

Daitaku Helios proved to be as good as her 
word. The two of us threw a totally hype 
victory party!
